title: PaginationMetaV1
description: Cursor-based pagination metadata. Document 10 section 4.6 forbids guessable offset pagination over elder data, so the cursor is opaque and must not be parsed by clients.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there is no next page. Clients must treat this as a blob and never construct one.

has_more.description: Whether further items exist beyond this page.
